1	# T06b Frame the sheet, add the loupe, and make the depth read — M8
2	Context: T06a built the stage and it works, but its screenshots (`qa/t06a/`) show what a first-time viewer cannot get past: the sheet is pushed off to one side and clipped by the stage (selecting a value translates it to the stage centre at a fixed zoom), a third of the stage is empty, and no printed figure on the scan can be read at that size. The idea of the page is "two printed sums cross at one value, and you can add it up yourself", so the viewer has to see the whole sheet with the crossing AND read the real digits. This task fixes the framing and adds a loupe. Same worktree and branch (`site`); other sessions are still changing `crossfoot/` on `main`. BASE: the current HEAD.
3	Read first: AGENTS.md, UI-SPEC.md (sections 5, 7, 12, 14), site/stage.js, site/styles.css, site/app.js, site/panel.js, crossfoot/sitebuild.py, .prod-build/reports/T06a.md, and open `qa/t06a/01-opening.png`, `03-failing.png` and `04-flat.png` to see the problem.
4	
5	Done when (REQUIRED): at 1440x900 with no input the whole sheet is inside the stage, tilted in depth, with the row band and the column band crossing at the selected value; above it a loupe shows the real scan pixels around that value large enough to read (printed digits at least 16 px tall on screen) with the same two bands and the ring, joined to the value on the sheet by a thin leader line; selecting another value (on the sheet, in the loupe, or from the list) moves all of it; nothing on the sheet is clipped by the stage in the tilted or the flat view; `uv run pytest -q` passes.
6	
7	The composition of the stage (at 1440x900 the stage is about 946 by 756 px):
8	- The sheet zone is the lower part of the stage (about 62 percent of its height). The whole page is always inside it with at least 24 px clear on every side: measure the sheet's projected box (`getBoundingClientRect` after the transform) and set the scale from that, again on resize, on page change and on Lay flat. Tilted view: `perspective: 1800px` on the stage, the sheet at about `rotateX(46deg) rotateZ(-3deg)` (a sheet lying on a desk, seen from the chair; try 40 to 50 and keep what reads best), its near edge parallel to the bottom of the stage. Flat view: no rotation, fitted the same way.
9	- Selecting a value no longer drags the sheet to the centre. The sheet answers with a small turn only: its z-rotation moves by at most 2 degrees toward the value and it slides by at most 40 px, eased over 600 ms, and it never leaves the sheet zone. The pointer lean from T06a stays (at most 3 degrees).
10	- The loupe is docked at the top centre of the stage, in the space above the sheet: a paper rectangle about 560 by 230 px with a 1 px ink border and a soft contact shadow (it is a second object above the desk, not glass: no blur, no gradient, no glow). It shows the scan itself around the selected value at a scale where a printed digit is at least 16 px tall: the value's column with one column on each side, and the block's rows from EARLY down to the small totals, so the column's whole sum can be read in it. The row band and the column band are drawn in it in the same colours, and the ring on the value. A value in the loupe can be clicked to select it. When the selection moves inside the same block the loupe's content slides to the new place (350 ms); across blocks or pages it cross-fades (150 ms). Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` it changes at once.
11	- A leader line (1.5 px, ink at 60 percent, round caps) runs from the bottom edge of the loupe to the ring on the sheet. It is an SVG overlay in stage coordinates; recompute its end from the ring's `getBoundingClientRect` on every frame while the sheet is moving, and on resize.
12	- The loupe needs sharper pixels than the 1,600 px page image. In `crossfoot/sitebuild.py` also write one image per block cut from the page at 300 dpi (`site/data/blocks/<county>-<block id>.webp`, grey, with the block's own box recorded in the county JSON so the loupe can place values), and load a block's image only when a value in it is selected. Keep the 1,600 px page images for the sheet. Tested: every block has an image entry whose pixel size matches its box at 300 dpi within a pixel.
13	- The blotter: one inset line (1 px, `--line`) 12 px inside the stage's edge with 8 px corners, nothing else. The sheet keeps its page stack, its contact shadow and its dimmer far edge; check the stack reads at the new tilt (edges of the pages under it visible along the near and right edges).
14	- Controls become one slim row at the bottom-left of the stage, on the blotter and clear of the sheet: the filled `Replay the audit` button (still disabled in this task; put its one-line reason in a `title` and in an `aria-describedby` text of 12 px beside the row, not in a card), then `Lay flat` / `Tilt sheet`, `Previous page`, `Next page`, `Page 1 of 6`. No dark card over the sheet.
15	- The tape reads as paper: `--sheet` background, a 1 px shadow line under it, and a torn lower edge cut with `clip-path` (a fine zigzag, 6 px deep). Keep its type and timing.
16	- The panel must not waste the first screen: at 1440x900 the tape, the selected-value card and at least four rows of the list are visible without scrolling the panel. Tighten spacing, and shorten the row tape as UI-SPEC says, before shrinking any type (nothing under 12 px).
17	
18	Fix on the way (from T06a's report): values that have no box (76 on page 1 in this run) cannot be shown on the sheet. Selecting one from the list or a tape opens the loupe on its block with a line "This value has no position in this run's data" and draws no ring, instead of jumping to another value.
19	
20	Look at it, and be hard on it: serve `site/` and take screenshots at 1440x900 with `uv run --with playwright python ...` (never `playwright install`): the opening state; a value in the first column; one in the last column (TOTAL side); a small total; a failing sum picked from the list; page 6; `?flat=1`; and 1024x768. Save them under `qa/t06b/`. Open every one. It is not done while any of these is true: part of the sheet is outside the stage; the loupe covers the ring or the bands' crossing on the sheet; the leader does not end on the ring; a band in the loupe is off its row or column by more than 2 px; digits in the loupe are blurred or under 16 px; two texts overlap; the first screen looks like a dashboard template rather than a desk with a sheet of paper on it. Say in the report what you changed after looking.
21	
22	You own (REQUIRED): modify site/ (all files), crossfoot/sitebuild.py, tests/test_sitebuild.py; create qa/t06b/. Touch nothing else: not hackathon.md, not .prod-build/plan.json, not .prod-build/evidence.jsonl, not any other file under crossfoot/.
23	Out of scope: the findings list and the finding card, the replay, the `?state=` screens, the layout under 900 px, deploy.

1	"""Builds the results page's data: `python -m crossfoot.sitebuild --run <run_id>`.
2	
3	Reads runs/<run_id>/<county>/county.json (fields: see outputs.py) and writes, under site/data/:
4	  index.json           run, started, ended, counties [{key, name, file, pages}], summary {county: figures the run
5	                       recorded}, run {model_calls, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, metered_cost_estimate}
6	  <county>.json        the county, with short keys (below), no indentation
7	  pages/<county>-pN.webp   each scan page at most 1600 px wide
8	
9	Short keys in <county>.json
10	  pages   [{n, img, w, h, sc}]   n page number, img path relative to site/, w and h image pixels,
11	                                 sc = image pixels per pixel of the run's 200 dpi boxes
12	  blocks  [{id, p, contest, cand, x}]            x = box in image pixels, or null
13	  values  [{p, b, r, c, v, s, x, m, n}]          cells and printed totals alike, in this order
14	            p page, b block, r row kind (cell) or 'col' / 'row' / 'grand' (printed total), c column (cell) or key
15	            (printed total), v value, s status (cells only), x box in image pixels or null (never a zero box),
16	            m model and n tries (cells only)
17	  checks  [{k, p, b, y, ok, pr, co, t}]          k row | col | grand, y key, pr printed, co computed,
18	            t = indexes into values, in the order the sum is added
19	  events  [{t, k, p}]                            ts, kind, payload, as recorded
20	  layout, run, county                            as recorded
21	"""
22	from __future__ import annotations
23	
24	import argparse
25	import json
26	from pathlib import Path
27	
28	MAX_WIDTH = 1600
29	RENDER_DPI = 200
30	
31	
32	def _scale_box(box, sc):
33	    """A box in 200 dpi pixels -> image pixels; None stays None, and so does anything that is not four numbers."""
34	    if not box or len(box) != 4 or any(v is None for v in box):
35	        return None
36	    return [round(v * sc, 1) for v in box]
37	
38	
39	def build_county(raw: dict, sizes: dict, img_path=lambda county, n: f"data/pages/{county}-p{n}.webp") -> dict:
40	    """The county's JSON for the page. `sizes` maps page number -> (render_w, render_h, img_w, img_h)."""
41	    county = raw["county"]
42	    pages, sc_of = [], {}
43	    for pg in raw["pages"]:
44	        n = pg["number"]
45	        if n not in sizes:
46	            raise ValueError(f"page {n} of {county} has no rendered size")
47	        rw, rh, iw, ih = sizes[n]
48	        # the boxes live in the frame of the recorded size when there is one, else of the render
49	        frame_w = pg.get("width") or rw
50	        sc = iw / frame_w
51	        sc_of[n] = sc
52	        pages.append({"n": n, "img": img_path(county, n), "w": iw, "h": ih, "sc": round(sc, 6)})
53	
54	    values, index = [], {}
55	
56	    def add(p, b, r, c, v, box, **extra):
57	        if (p, b, r, c) in index:
58	            raise ValueError(f"value {p}:{b}:{r}:{c} appears twice in {county}")
59	        index[(p, b, r, c)] = len(values)
60	        d = {"p": p, "b": b, "r": r, "c": c, "v": v, "x": _scale_box(box, sc_of.get(p, 1.0))}
61	        d.update(extra)
62	        values.append(d)
63	
64	    for c in raw["cells"]:
65	        add(c["page"], c["block"], c["row_kind"], str(c["column"]), c["value"], c.get("box"),
66	            s=c["status"], m=c.get("model"), n=c.get("tries"))
67	    for t in raw["totals"]:
68	        add(t["page"], t["block"], t["direction"], str(t["key"]), t["value"], t.get("box"))
69	
70	    checks = []
71	    for ch in raw["checks"]:
72	        refs = []
73	        for key, _ in ch["terms"]:
74	            p, b, r, c = key
75	            k = (p, b, r, str(c))
76	            if k not in index:
77	                raise ValueError(f"check {ch['kind']} {ch['page']}:{ch['block']}:{ch['key']} names a term "
78	                                 f"{p}:{b}:{r}:{c} that is not a value")
79	            refs.append(index[k])
80	        checks.append({"k": ch["kind"], "p": ch["page"], "b": ch["block"], "y": str(ch["key"]), "ok": bool(ch["ok"]),
81	                       "pr": ch["printed"], "co": ch["computed"], "t": refs})
82	
83	    blocks = [{"id": b["id"], "p": b["page"], "contest": b["contest"], "cand": b.get("candidate"),
84	               "x": _scale_box(b.get("box"), sc_of.get(b["page"], 1.0))} for b in raw["blocks"]]
85	    return {"county": county, "run": raw["run_id"], "layout": raw["layout"], "pages": pages, "blocks": blocks,
86	            "values": values, "checks": checks,
87	            "events": [{"t": e["ts"], "k": e["kind"], "p": e["payload"]} for e in raw["events"]]}
88	
89	
90	def render_pages(county: str, page_numbers, out_dir: Path, data_root=None, max_width=MAX_WIDTH) -> dict:
91	    """Renders each page at 200 dpi (cached by crossfoot.render), saves a WebP at most max_width wide."""
92	    from PIL import Image
93	    from .render import page_png
94	    from .sources import DATA
95	    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
96	    sizes = {}
97	    for n in page_numbers:
98	        with Image.open(page_png(county, n, RENDER_DPI, data_root or DATA)) as im:
99	            rw, rh = im.size
100	            iw = min(max_width, rw)
101	            ih = round(rh * iw / rw)
102	            im.convert("L").resize((iw, ih), Image.LANCZOS).save(out_dir / f"{county}-p{n}.webp", quality=88, method=6)
103	        sizes[n] = (rw, rh, iw, ih)
104	    return sizes
105	
106	
107	def build(run_id: str, runs_dir="runs", out="site/data", counties=None, data_root=None) -> list[str]:
108	    run_dir = Path(runs_dir) / run_id
109	    out = Path(out)
110	    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
111	    meta = json.loads((run_dir / "run.json").read_text()) if (run_dir / "run.json").exists() else {}
112	    keys = counties or sorted(p.parent.name for p in run_dir.glob("*/county.json"))
113	    if not keys:
114	        raise SystemExit(f"no county.json under {run_dir}")
115	    index = {"run": run_id, "started": meta.get("started"), "ended": meta.get("ended"), "counties": [], "summary": {},
116	             "run_totals": {k: meta[k] for k in ("model_calls", "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens",
117	                                                 "metered_cost_estimate") if k in meta}}
118	    for key in keys:
119	        raw = json.loads((run_dir / key / "county.json").read_text())
120	        sizes = render_pages(key, [p["number"] for p in raw["pages"]], out / "pages", data_root)
121	        d = build_county(raw, sizes)
122	        (out / f"{key}.json").write_text(json.dumps(d, separators=(",", ":")))
123	        index["counties"].append({"key": key, "name": key.replace("_", " ").title(), "file": f"data/{key}.json",
124	                                  "pages": len(d["pages"])})
125	        index["summary"][key] = raw.get("summary", {})
126	    (out / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, separators=(",", ":")))
127	    return keys
128	
129	
130	def main(argv=None):
131	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m crossfoot.sitebuild")
132	    ap.add_argument("--run", required=True)
133	    ap.add_argument("--runs-dir", default="runs")
134	    ap.add_argument("--out", default="site/data")
135	    ap.add_argument("--county", action="append")
136	    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
137	    keys = build(a.run, a.runs_dir, a.out, a.county)
138	    print(f"wrote {a.out}/index.json and {len(keys)} county file(s): {', '.join(keys)}")
139	
140	
141	if __name__ == "__main__":
142	    main()

## 7. Choreography

| id | trigger | from -> to | what moves | pattern | timing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T-01 | select a finding | list -> sheet | the sheet turns so the cell is centred; the row line draws, then the column line; the ring closes | draw-on onto its cause | turn 600ms ease-in-out; lines 350ms each; ring 180ms |
| T-02 | T-01 ends | sheet -> tape | the tape prints its lines; the total line lands last | stepped print | 60ms a line, at most 900ms |
| T-03 | Replay | finished -> replaying | recorded events play in order: cells appear, failing sums show red, a re-read cell flips, sums turn blue | in-page replay, labelled "Replay · run of <date>, at <n>x" | 40 events a second by default |
| T-04 | Lay flat | tilted -> flat | the sheet's rotation eases to zero | same thing, different view | 400ms |

Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: no turn, no draw-on, no stepped print; states change with a 150ms fade. Replay still steps through events, with a visible Pause.

- Top bar: `Crossfoot` · `audits public election data against the certified scans`
- Primary: `Replay the audit` / `Pause replay`
- Controls: `Lay flat` / `Tilt sheet` · `Previous page` · `Next page`
- Finding card labels: `Public file` · `Scan` · `Kind of slip` · `Decided by`
- Kinds: `wrong number` · `wrong column` · `wrong precinct` · `missing row` · `row fails its own total`
- Statuses: `Settled by the printed totals` · `Read from the scan by the agent. A person has not confirmed this yet.` · `No printed total can decide this. Left as published.` · `The document disagrees with itself. Listed for a person.`
- Tape: `adds to` · `printed total` · `matches` · `does not match`
- Buttons on the card: `Open crop` · `Evidence file`
- Run numbers: `cells audited` · `right on first read` · `right after re-reads` · `re-read` · `disagreements` · `settled` · `model cost` · `minutes`
- Replay label: `Replay · run of {date} · {n}x`
- Empty: `No disagreements in this county.`
- Error: `Couldn't load {file}. Reload, or open the repository's runs folder.`
- First-run: `No run has been built into this page yet. Run crossfoot site build.`
- Footer: `These are transcription slips in a volunteer dataset. Each county's certified scan is the source of truth. Sources: the OpenElections sources and data repositories for the 2024 Texas general election.` (with links)

## 10. Brand

Mark: on a 48 grid, a horizontal stroke and a vertical stroke crossing, with a ring where they cross; two flat colours (pencil blue, pencil red) on the dark stage, ink on light. Wordmark: `Crossfoot` in Public Sans 800, -0.03em. Favicon: the mark as `favicon.svg`.

## 11. Real-product checks

Value: it shows which cells to fix and why. Clarity: the first screen is a finished run. Trust: every finding shows the printed total and a crop; nothing shows a confidence percentage. Feedback: selection responds in under 100ms. Failure: a missing file names itself and the rest of the page still renders. 10x data: page images are loaded one at a time and the list is virtualised above 200 rows. Maintainability: no dependencies.

No gradients, glows or glass. No confetti, no sounds. No percentages of confidence. No candidate, party or official mentioned outside the scan's own row labels. No number that is not in the run's files. Nothing that moves without a visible Pause.
